newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor rises nearly 3 pct on tax move.
newsitem.headline: Investor rises nearly 3 pct on tax move.

text.p: Swedish investment company Investor AB jumped nearly three percent early Friday after a Swedish newspaper reported proposed tax changes that would cut the amount of tax payable if an investment company split up.
By 0830 GMT Investor was seven crown higher at 253 crowns.
"There is probably a 25-35 percent gain for every investment company if these changes go through," said a broker at Matteus. "You can expect a nice rally in the sector over the next few days."
The investment sector jumped 2.99 percent in early trade while the market overall was 0.16 percent higher.

Daily business paper Finanstidningen said Tax Minister Thomas Ostros will next week propose tax changes for investment companies so they are only subjected to capital gains tax if they split and not a list of other taxes that currently apply.
